question: Does an unsupported frozen secondary tag without post-freeze mutation invalidate the 40-case primary comparison?
reasoning: The committed invalidation table triggers whole-comparison invalidation when secondary tags change after freeze. An already-frozen unsupported annotation is a metadata defect, not the registered change-after-freeze event. Neither PVC-008 nor PVC-009 changes source/objective, allocation, primary count, label evidence, or freshness eligibility. Their primary comparisons remain valid on all original 40 IDs and preregistered denominators. Preserve the frozen tags and report their unsupported dates_times membership as a secondary-cohort limitation. Do not silently remove or recategorize these cases, recompute a replacement cohort as preregistered, or alter advancement thresholds. Integrity/advancement still requires explicit disclosure and appropriate assessment of this deviation; this opinion does not independently certify every future gate.
